analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

63MOONS.technical: Completing a 23.8% deep cup with a 10.5% handle double bottom. Price maintains alignment above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with RSI at 63, indicating healthy cyclical momentum toward the 982.83 neckline trigger.
63MOONS.fundamental: Lacks CANSLIM backing. Operating margins remain erratic, 5-year sales growth is subdued at 5.7%, and interest coverage is weak despite zero debt. Promoter holding is stable at 45.6% with no pledging.
63MOONS.risk: Thesis breaks below handle support at 886.75; cut quickly if the double-bottom pivot fails to attract volume.

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Hovering within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot at 114.91 on 1.66x volume expansion. Price holds above all moving averages with RSI 61, but lacks confirmed Stage 2 relative strength leadership.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Severe fundamental deterioration under CANSLIM rules. Sales contracted 56.3% YoY and net profit fell 25.6%. Low 3-year average ROE of 3.1% and poor interest coverage offer no institutional sponsorship catalyst.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Violation of the 104.57 stop invalidates the pivot structure; honor tight risk limits immediately.

AARTIDRUGS.technical: Forming an aligned double-bottom base within 1.5% of the 513.51 pivot. Price trades comfortably above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with bullish MACD momentum above zero.
AARTIDRUGS.fundamental: Turnaround showing traction. Q2 revenue expanded 22.4% and net profit rebounded +38.1% on firming operating margins (13.8%). Return on capital is 12% with debt-to-equity manageable at 0.5x, though promoter holding remains stable at 55.2%.
AARTIDRUGS.risk: Pattern fails if price drops below 455.37; exit decisively to prevent exposure to deeper base drag.

AARTIPHARM.technical: Textbook SEPA breakout to fresh all-time/52-week highs, clearing 1003.4 on massive 2.96x volume. Strong relative strength and clean moving average stack confirm textbook Stage 2 leadership.
AARTIPHARM.fundamental: High-grade CANSLIM profile. Exceptional Q2 PAT surged 156% to ₹71.5 Cr with sales climbing 45.9%, driven by expanding CDMO margins. Robust balance sheet, conservative gearing, and 19%+ ROE reinforce institutional accumulation.
AARTIPHARM.risk: Close below the 907.75 swing low voids the breakout; enforce Minervini stop discipline without hesitation.

AARVI.technical: Consolidating near pivot resistance at 161.16 above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. MACD is positive above the signal line, displaying constructive contraction characteristics.
AARVI.fundamental: Solid earnings acceleration with Q1 profit up 41.8% YoY on steady manpower contract additions. Low debt, stable 73.4% promoter holding, and modest ROCE (14.7%) offset historically thin operating margins near 3.5%.
AARVI.risk: A breakdown below 146.04 negates base integrity; execute capital preservation rules swiftly.

ABCAPITAL.technical: High-conviction SEPA breakout clearing 20-session highs at 416.87 on 2.87x average volume. Moving averages are stacked in classic Minervini trend template alignment with strong relative strength.
ABCAPITAL.fundamental: Strong institutional sponsorship backing. Consolidated Q2 profit increased 35% to ₹1,237 Cr on 22.5% revenue growth, supported by robust lending spreads and asset management expansion. Promoters hold 68.8% with zero pledge.
ABCAPITAL.risk: Failure to hold the 390.48 breakout platform breaches the trade thesis; trigger immediate stop loss.
